# ADDIS Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions — Complete Bilingual Knowledge Profile (EN / AR)

## 1. Corporate Identity & History
- **English Name**: ADDIS Logistics & Supply Chain Solutions
- **Arabic Name**: أديس للخدمات اللوجستية وحلول سلاسل الإمداد
- **Founded**: 2009 (تأسست عام 2009)
- **Global Reach**: Import & export air, sea, and multimodal forwarding across **150+ countries** worldwide (تغطية +150 دولة حول العالم)
- **Operational Commitment**: Strategic carrier partnerships with major airlines, shipowners, and maritime lines enabling competitive pricing, priority space allocation, and end-to-end customs & ground execution.
- **Website**: https://addislogistics-ye.com
- **Primary Email**: info@addislogistics-ye.com
- **Direct WhatsApp**: +967 772900086 (https://wa.me/967772900086)
- **Office Phone**: +967 1317338

## 2. Strategic Branch Network (4 Hubs)
1. **Sana'a, Yemen (صنعاء، اليمن)** — Headquarters & Central Operations Control
   - Responsibilities: Executive dispatch, air freight coordination, diplomatic/humanitarian NGO cargo desk, nationwide distribution planning, and 24/7 client support.
2. **Aden, Yemen (عدن، اليمن)** — Southern Seaport, Free Zone & Airport Hub
   - Responsibilities: Aden Container Terminal (ACT) & Aden International Airport (ADE) clearance, FCL/LCL stripping, bonded storage, and southern corridor road dispatch.
3. **Hodeidah, Yemen (الحديدة، اليمن)** — Red Sea Maritime Port Hub
   - Responsibilities: Red Sea container & breakbulk vessel operations, bulk/project cargo unloading, port agency coordination, and overland transit customs.
4. **Istanbul, Turkey (إسطنبول، تركيا)** — Euro-Asian Consolidation & Trade Hub
   - Responsibilities: Global air & sea export consolidation from Turkey & Europe into Yemen and the Middle East, supplier verification, LCL/FCL loading, and multimodal trade forwarding across 150+ countries.

## 3. Comprehensive Service Portfolio (6 Core Pillars)

### 3.1 Air Freight (الشحن الجوي)
- Door-to-Door International Air Freight
- Special Cargo Handling & Time-Critical Express
- Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR / IATA Certified)
- Perishable & Cold-Chain Goods (Pharmaceuticals, Fresh Produce)
- High-Value Cargo & Secure Vault Escorts
- Full & Part Aircraft Charters (شحن جوي عاجل وطائرات مستأجرة)

### 3.2 Sea Freight (الشحن البحري)
- FCL 20ft, 40ft & 40ft High-Cube Containers (حاويات كاملة 20 و 40 قدماً)
- LCL Consolidation & Groupage Services (تجميع الشحنات الجزئية)
- ISO Tank Containers for Bulk Liquids & Chemicals
- Flexitank Container Solutions for Non-Hazardous Liquid Cargo
- Ship Brokerage, Port Agency & Vessel Chartering (وساطة بحرية وتأجير سفن)

### 3.3 Road Freight (الشحن البري)
- LTL & FTL Fleet Management (إدارة الشحن الجزئي والكامل بالشاحنات)
- Regional & Cross-Border Long-Distance Trucking
- Transit Customs Processing at Land Borders
- Heavy Haulage Route Permits & Regulatory Clearances
- Dedicated Security Escorts & GPS Fleet Tracking (تصاريح ومرافقة أمنية)

### 3.4 Project Cargo (شحن المشاريع الثقيلة)
- Heavy Lift & Oversized Industrial Equipment
- Out-of-Gauge (OOG) Flat-Rack & Open-Top Transport
- Breakbulk Stevedoring & Port-to-Site Rigging
- Air & Ship Charters for Energy, Telecom & Construction
- Humanitarian Relief, NGO & Specialized Defense/Military Cargo

### 3.5 Warehousing & Distribution (التخزين والتوزيع)
- Bonded & Free-Zone Warehousing near Ports & Airports
- Temperature-Controlled & General Storage Facilities
- Real-Time Inventory Management, Barcoding & Stock Audits
- Pick, Pack, Labeling, Palletizing & Repackaging
- Nationwide Collection & Last-Mile Distribution Fleet

### 3.6 Customs Clearance (التخليص الجمركي)
- Full Import & Export Customs Brokerage (تخليص جمركي للاستيراد والتصدير)
- Harmonized System (HS) Tariff Classification & Duty Optimization
- Airport & Seaport Clearance in Sana'a, Aden, Hodeidah & Istanbul
- Phytosanitary, Ministry Approvals, NGO Exemptions & Transit Carnets

## 4. Vertical Markets Served
